arxiv-2110-00391.title: Online Primal-Dual Algorithms with Predictions for Packing Problems
arxiv-2110-00391.creator: Nguyễn Kim Thắng, Christoph Dürr
arxiv-2110-00391.description: Abstract The domain of online algorithms with predictions has been extensively studied for different applications such as scheduling, caching (paging), clustering, ski rental, etc. Recently, Bamas et al., aiming for an unified method, have provided a primal-dual framework for linear covering problems.

arxiv-2202-00339.title: Quantifying relevance in learning and inference Journal: Physics Reports
arxiv-2202-00339.creator: Matteo Marsili, Yasser Roudi
arxiv-2202-00339.description: Abstract Learning is a distinctive feature of intelligent behaviour. High-throughput experimental data and Big Data promise to open new windows on complex systems such as cells, the brain or our societies. Yet, the puzzling success of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning shows that we still have a poor conceptual understanding of learning.

arxiv-2203-08150.title: A physics and data co-driven surrogate modeling approach for temperature field prediction on irregular geometric domain
arxiv-2203-08150.creator: Kairui Bao 1, Wen Yao 2,*, Xiaoya Zhang 2,*, Wei Peng 2, Yu Li 2
arxiv-2203-08150.description: Abstract In the whole aircraft structural optimization loop, thermal analysis plays a very important role. But it faces a severe computational burden when directly applying traditional numerical analysis tools, especially when each optimization involves repetitive parameter modification and thermal analysis followed.

arxiv-2203-09162.title: Interactions between the individual and the group level in organizations
arxiv-2203-09162.creator: Dario Blanco-Fernandez, Stephan Leitner, Alexandra Rausch
arxiv-2203-09162.description: Abstract Previous research on organizations often focuses on either the individual, team, or organizational level. There is a lack of multidimensional research on emergent phenomena and interactions between the mechanisms at different levels. This paper takes a multifaceted perspective on individual learning and autonomous group formation and adaptation.

arxiv-2209-02640.title: Enumerative geometry meets statistics, combinatorics and topology
arxiv-2209-02640.creator: Mateusz Michałek
arxiv-2209-02640.description: Abstract We explain connections among several, a priori unrelated, areas of mathematics: combinatorics, algebraic statistics, topology, and enumerative algebraic geometry. Our focus is on discrete invariants, strongly related to the theory of Lorentzian polynomials. The main concept joining the mentioned fields is a linear space of matrices. The author is funded by the Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft –- Projektnummer 467575307.

arxiv-2211-03095.title: Cyclability, Connectivity and Circumference
arxiv-2211-03095.creator: Niranjan Balachandran, Anish Hebbar
arxiv-2211-03095.description: Abstract In a graph G G , a subset of vertices S ⊆ V ⁡ ( G ) S\subseteq V(G) is said to be cyclable if there is a cycle containing the vertices in some order. G G is said to be k k -cyclable if any subset of k ≥ 2 k\geq 2 vertices is cyclable.

arxiv-2307-07338.title: Collisions of red giants in galactic nuclei 2022 Collisions of red giants in galactic nuclei –
arxiv-2307-07338.creator: Taeho Ryu, Pau Amaro Seoane, Andrew M. Taylor, Sebastian T. Ohlmann
arxiv-2307-07338.description: Abstract In stellar-dense environments, stars can collide with each other. For collisions close to a supermassive black hole (SMBH), the collisional kinetic energy can be so large that the colliding stars can be destroyed, potentially releasing an amount of energy comparable to that of a supernova.

arxiv-2312-10295.title: On a Generalization of Wasserstein Distance and the Beckmann Problem to Connection Graphs
arxiv-2312-10295.creator: Sawyer Robertson ∗,† , Dhruv Kohli ∗,† , Gal Mishne § , Alexander Cloninger †,§
arxiv-2312-10295.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Sawyer Robertson ∗,† , Dhruv Kohli ∗,† , Gal Mishne § , Alexander Cloninger †,§. We propose a model of optimal parallel transport between vector fields on a connection graph, which consists of a weighted graph along with a map from its edges to an orthogonal group.

arxiv-2404-01329.title: Unraveling the Dynamics of Television Debates and Social Media Engagement: Insights from an Indian News Show
arxiv-2404-01329.creator: Kiran Garimella Abhilash Datta
arxiv-2404-01329.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Kiran Garimella Abhilash Datta. The relationship between television shows and social media has become increasingly intertwined in recent years. Social media platforms, particularly Twitter, have emerged as significant sources of public opinion and discourse on topics discussed in television shows. In India, news debates leverage the popularity of social media to promote hashtags and engage users in discussions and debates on a daily basis.

arxiv-2404-09967.title: C t r l -Adapter: An Efficient and Versatile Framework for Adapting Diverse Controls to Any Diffusion Model
arxiv-2404-09967.creator: Han Lin, Jaemin Cho, Abhay Zala, Mohit Bansal
arxiv-2404-09967.description: Abstract ControlNets are widely used for adding spatial control to text-to-image diffusion models with different conditions, such as depth maps, scribbles/sketches, and human poses. However, when it comes to controllable video generation, ControlNets cannot be directly integrated into new backbones due to feature space mismatches, and training ControlNets for new backbones can be a significant burden for many users.

arxiv-2405-10784.title: STONY BROOK UNIVERSITY
arxiv-2405-10784.description: Abstract Abstract Correlation functions form the basis of Conformal Field Theories. These functions for two-point and three-point function have a restrictive closed form. In AdS/CFT the boundary of the geometry is where the CFT lives in d-dimensions, while the bulk is described by the AdS geometry living in d+1 dimensions.

pmc-10539884.title: High spatial resolution dataset of grapevine yield components at the within-field level
pmc-10539884.creator: Baptiste Oger, Yulin Zhang, Jean-Philippe Gras, Yoann Valloo, Pauline Faure, Guilhem Brunel, Bruno Tisseyre
pmc-10539884.description: In order to enhance the understanding of vine yield development and facilitate the design of innovative agricultural practices in viticulture (i.e., new estimation methods), it is essential to have accurate and detailed data on vine yield components, including unproductive vines, number of bunches, and bunch weight.

pmc-10647606.title: Diverse Bradyrhizobium spp. with Similar Symbiosis Genes Nodulate Peanut in Different Regions of China: Characterization of Symbiovar sv. Arachis
pmc-10647606.creator: Junjie Zhang, Yufeng Feng, Jingqi Wang, Entao Wang, Mitchell Andrews
pmc-10647606.description: A total of 219 rhizobial strains isolated from peanut grown in soils from six peanut croplands in Zhengyang county, Henan Province, were typed by PCR-RFLP of IGS sequences. Their phylogenetic relationships were refined on representative strains using sequence analyses of 16S rRNA genes, housekeeping genes (atpD, recA, glnII) and symbiosis genes (nodA, nodC and nifH).

pmc-13072049.title: Key Factors Influencing the Adoption of CAD/CAM in the Fabrication of Indirect Dental Restorations
pmc-13072049.creator: Ana Kahurangi Conway Downey, Vincent Bennani, Arthi Veerasamy, Hannah Wesley
pmc-13072049.description: IntroductionOver recent decades, CAD/CAM (computer assisted design/computer assisted manufacture) has become increasingly prevalent in dentistry. These systems offer alternatives to various stages of the conventional workflow for indirect restorations. While CAD/CAM has been explored in previous studies, their use in New Zealand (NZ) remains under‐researched.

pmc-13096403.title: Quality of life in children with defecation disorders compared with healthy
pmc-13096403.creator: Yang Yang, Ting An, Liwei Feng, Yuanyuan Liang
pmc-13096403.description: To investigate the quality of life of children with defecation disorders by comparing with a healthy control group. A cross-sectional study enrolled children with defecation disorders from a tertiary hospital (June–July 2024) and age- and sex-frequency matched healthy controls from three communities (August 2024). Participants were recruited according to the inclusion and exclusion criteria.

pmc-13239943.title: Bayesian Evaluation of Treatment Effect of Avelumab Plus Axitinib for Advanced Renal Cell Carcinoma
pmc-13239943.creator: Wataru Fukuokaya, Keiichiro Mori, Takafumi Yanagisawa, Kagenori Ito, Yu Imai, Fumihiko Urabe, Pawel Rajwa, Shahrokh F Shariat, Takahiro Kimura, Akihiro Hirakawa
pmc-13239943.description: BackgroundDespite not achieving statistical significance, the JAVELIN Renal 101 trial indicated a potentially clinically relevant effect size (hazard ratio [HR], 0.88; 95% confidence interval, 0.75 to 1.04) on overall survival (OS) favoring avelumab plus axitinib over sunitinib for advanced renal cell carcinoma (aRCC). To better interpret these findings, we performed a Bayesian evaluation.

pmc-13297428.title: Bacterial-Derived Immunomodulators as a Preventive Strategy for Viral Respiratory Tract Infections and Associated Wheezing or Asthma in Children: A Targeted Narrative Review
pmc-13297428.creator: Manuel E. Soto-Martinez, Wojciech Feleszko, Alexander Moeller
pmc-13297428.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Highlights What are the main findings? Four bacterial-derived immunomodulators (OM-85, PMBL, MV130, and CRL1505) share convergent mechanisms involving epithelial barrier reinforcement, innate immune activation, and adaptive immune modulation relevant to pediatric respiratory infection prevention.Clinical evidence varies substantially across products, with OM-85 demonstrating the most extensive support (showing 26–36% reduction in respiratory tract infections across multiple RCTs and meta-analyses), while data for PMBL, MV130, and CRL1505 remain more limited. What are the implications of the main findings?

pmc-13402587.title: The prevalence of E198A and F200Y single nucleotide polymorphism in Haemonchus contortus populations from Polish goat herds
pmc-13402587.creator: Zofia Nowek, Marcin Mickiewicz, Michał Czopowicz, Agata Moroz-Fik, Adrian-Valentin Potărniche, Kinga Biernacka, Tomasz Nalbert, Olga Szaluś-Jordanow, Paweł Górski, Alistair Antonopoulos, Iwona Markowska-Daniel, Emilia Bagnicka, Marián Várady, Jarosław Kaba
pmc-13402587.description: A cross-sectional descriptive study was carried out on a study population of 81 goat herds to investigate the prevalence and frequency of two single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs; E198A and F200Y) associated with resistance to benzimidazoles (BZ) in Haemonchus contortus populations of goats in Poland.

pmc-13509840.title: Disruption of Antioxidant Defense Systems in Honey Bees and Wild Bees Under Environmental Xenobiotic Pressure
pmc-13509840.creator: Ivana Tlak Gajger, Josipa Vlainić, Aleksandar Cvetkovikj
pmc-13509840.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Honey bee colonies play a vital role in ecosystem stability and global food security. Together with bumble bees and other wild bee species, they form a diverse pollinator community that is particularly vulnerable to environmental pollution.

pmc-13533478.title: Using Machine Learning with the Brief Symptom Inventory to Screen for Comorbid Addictions: A Proof-of-Principle Study
pmc-13533478.creator: Maor Daniel Levitin, Dvora Shmulewitz, Roi Eliashar, Shaul Lev-Ran, Mario Mikulincer
pmc-13533478.description: IntroductionMental health disorders are leading causes of morbidity worldwide and often co-occur with substance use and other addictive behaviors. However, many individuals in mental healthcare settings are not screened for addictions. General psychopathology measures, such as the Brief Symptom Inventory (BSI), may offer valuable insights into addiction risk.
